run_aggregate_cli: run the aggregate module CLI to generate accuracy tables for model predictions across factors and partitions
generate_all_tables: generate accuracy and calibration tables for multiple models, factors, and error types from model predictions
compute_factor_accuracies: compute per-factor accuracy for each model by grouping predictions and comparing correct counts to totals
compute_factor_calibration_errors: compute estimated calibration error per factor for each model using binned confidence vs correctness
worst_k_class_acc: compute the average accuracy across the worst K classes for each model in the dataset
